request.style: English, male gritty rock vocal, electric guitar, bass guitar, drums, keyboard, dark aggressive mood, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I will confront you with your detestable deeds
City that sheds blood in her midst
You have brought guilt upon yourself
By idols you have defiled yourself

[Chorus]
City of blood, city of foul name
A mockery to every land
I will scatter you among the nations
And disperse you through the lands

[Verse]
Princes rely on the strength of their arm
Treating father and mother with contempt
Oppressing the stranger, wronging the orphan
Despising what is holy to me

[Chorus]
City of blood, city of foul name
A mockery to every land
I will scatter you among the nations
And disperse you through the lands

[Verse]
The house of Israel has become dross to me
Copper, tin, iron, and lead in the furnace
I will gather you into the middle
And put you in to melt you down

[Chorus]
City of blood, city of foul name
A mockery to every land
I will scatter you among the nations
And disperse you through the lands

[Bridge]
Prophets conspire like roaring lions tearing prey
Priests make no distinction between holy and common
Officials are like wolves destroying lives
I searched for one to repair the wall

[Outro]
But I found no one to stand in the breach
So I have poured out my indignation
